svg.title: Agronomist — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as agronomist, wearing a work jacket and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: A crop’s leaves rise above a two-layer soil block while visible roots branch through the soil. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap.
